title: CE41025: Environmental Ecology And Microbiology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fundamentals of Ecology: Producers, consumers and decomposers; Food chain and
trophic levels; Energy flows in ecosystems; estimates of primary production;
Populations, communities and ecosystems; Species interactions; Population
growth and dynamics; Biomes: terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems Fundamentals of
Environmental Microbiology: Introduction: overview of microbiology and cell
biology; Classification of organisms and cells, microscopy; Cell chemistry and
structures; Nutrition, metabolism and biosynthesis; Growth and its control;
Energetics and stoichiometry of growth; Metabolic diversity among
microorganisms; Biogeochemical cycles; Microbe-human interactions; Major
microbial diseases - airborne, waterborne, food-borne.
